description: Na₃MgCo₂SbO₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.57 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Sb and four O atoms. The Na-Sb bond length is 3.12 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.43 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.15 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.15 Å. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na and four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.26 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Co atoms to form distorted ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids and edges with five ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, one Co, and one Sb atom to form ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Co atoms to form distorted ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids and edges with five ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, one Co, and one Sb atom to form ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom to form ONa₃MgSb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, two Co, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONaMgCo₂Sb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids and edges with four ONa₂MgCoSb trigonal bipyramids.
